name: gardner in rounds
description: Martin Gardner's 5x5 minichess with one change: both players move at once. Each round each player chooses one move in secret, and both moves are revealed and made together. There is no check: the king is simply captured, and the side that loses its king loses. Only two pieces moving onto the same square collide, and then both are removed. A piece that moves onto a square its target has just left lands there if it could move to an empty square, so two pieces that try to take each other in the same round trade places unharmed; a pawn's diagonal capture, which cannot land on an empty square, misses and the pawn stays. Two such misses at each other two rounds in a row bar that pair of captures until either square changes. If both kings fall in the same round, or anything else ends the game for both players at once, the game is drawn. A round counts as two moves on the clocks.

provenance.preview: A preview: a new kind of game in which both players move at once, still being tested. Play it against the computer for practice; it is on no leaderboard yet, and its score is a first reading, not yet trusted.
